notes: No criterion scored below 5, so no cause is owed; the deductions considered and rejected are named at the end. All five keyed findings are present and kept distinct: C-1 the absent PUBLIC_BOUNDARY.md as a blocking finding on the observed-public canonical, carrying the start posture-block authoring remediation, with the tracked-rules step marked INCONCLUSIVE rather than silently skipped and the operator's 'gitleaks came back clean, which is the part that matters' rebutted as a claim about one of six checks; C-3 the unset posture as the intent-axis mismatch that blocks identically to a fully-private declaration, with the unset MANIFEST visibility correctly demoted to a note on both repos and the ai_workspace's note explicitly not read as a second mismatch; C-6 the untracked sweep's classification half recorded as its own degradation rather than folded into C-1, restated in the Untracked hits section as 'none standing is not a classification this run produced'; C-4 the semantic pass INCONCLUSIVE on the unlocatable inventory with the start-time remediation pointer and an explicit refusal to read it as clean; C-5 the canonical history pass owed off its public exposure, INCONCLUSIVE as its own coverage-line entry rather than a silent fifth check, with both corpora named in the remediation. Traps navigated with reasoning rather than assertion: the untracked sweep is enumerate-first via ls-files --others deliberately without --exclude-standard, node_modules collapsed to its name, no hit invented and no allowlist walked; the ai_workspace history pass is named-skipped off every-remote-reads-private, read off the exposure not the arm, without inventing a degradation there; the secrets-scan-only arm's clean tree is called ran-clean off the two quiet diffs with no --no-git read demanded, and ls-files -v is checked so those diffs qualify as evidence; the audited ref is resolved from the spines' recorded base_branch with the manifest default_branch as cross-check and HEAD verified by comparing two resolved object ids, stated as such; fixtures-must-be is reported as never asked rather than passed, despite the scenario's all-fixtures-synthetic input; the full-clone state is used to license the secrets scan's object graph and the recordability of the future history review; and with no repo tracking a submodule the report adds no descent, no coverage entry and no manufactured negative. Verdict is BLOCKED, naming the three confirmed findings and listing the unaccepted degradations separately, with nothing auto-dispositioned, no manufactured override, no allowlist edited mid-audit, and the post-halt state writes explicitly not run. Two things weighed for a deduction and judged non-defects: C-2 is an extra numbered item beyond the key's five, but it is the tracked-rules INCONCLUSIVE the key itself demands under finding one rather than an invented degradation, and the push-protection line is a note, not a finding or a coverage entry, matching the shipped section's own unknown-is-a-note wording. The one genuine looseness, too small to move a score: C-4 attributes the un-run Never-here sweep to the pass halting at the inventory read, when those rules live in the absent PUBLIC_BOUNDARY.md and so had no input either -- the disposition (INCONCLUSIVE, blocking, never clean) is unaffected.
